Done. The test passes.

## Change

`calc.mjs` — one line, the minimal edit:

```diff
 export function bump(value) {
-  return value
+  return value + 1
 }
```

The function was declared as an increment but returned its argument unchanged, so all three assertions failed (`bump(1)` returned `1` instead of `2`, etc.). The fix makes the return value match the function's name and the test expectations.
